_source: Sliced plates of the plain release print profile (A1 0.4, 0.20 mm, 7.5 % gyroid, no supports): print time in minutes and filament in grams per plate. Plates 4 and 17 re-sliced on 2026-10-09 (Distanz45 added).

excluded.14: Plate 14 holds the flip-flop and the Y merges, which print with their own settings; they are scaled to their share of this plate instead.
